FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Floral Essence Creations specializes in retailing artificial flowers and a wide range of floral supplies. We operate a physical storefront located in Flower City, FL, where we offer a diverse selection of high-quality, synthetic floral arrangements ideal for various occasions including weddings, anniversaries, and home decor. Our operations place a strong emphasis on product sales and customer consultations, ensuring a personalized shopping experience for our clients.

To maintain the integrity of our products, we have established climate-controlled storage areas that secure our bulk inventory, particularly heat-sensitive materials. Our commitment to safety is reflected in our documented employee training programs covering operational procedures and safety protocols. We also uphold compliance with local zoning and fire regulations, ensuring a legally compliant and safe working environment.

While we occasionally participate in local trade shows to promote our offerings, more than 50% of our revenue comes from our retail operations rather than online sales or delivery services. We prioritize maintaining a low-risk profile by avoiding high-risk activities such as complex event installations or the use of hazardous materials beyond standard cleaning agents. Our operations are structured to prevent any exposure to undue liabilities while providing customers with exceptional quality and service.
